# Flows (v20.2.0)

<!-- Generated by tools/build_adapters.py from registry/ — do not edit; change the manifest and re-run. -->

The active flow is `.cecilia/config.json` → `flow` (only Cecilia changes it: `cecilia flow <name>`); its settings live under `flows.<name>`. Every flow declares the steps `intake`, `plan`, `approve`, `dispatch`, `review`, `handoff`, `finish` and its guide has one `## <step>` section per step.

| Flow | Summary | Steps | Guide | Rules slot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| personal | Cecilia works alone on her own project (v19.2 behaviour): task from chat, local-only, she pushes and opens PRs herself. | intake → plan → approve → dispatch → review → handoff → finish | `shared/flows/personal.md` | `rules/flows/personal.md` |
| team | Cecilia works in a team: ticket intake, branch/commit/PR-template rules, escalation to the leader, docs export, PR size limit, reading review comments. | intake → plan → approve → dispatch → review → handoff → finish | `shared/flows/team.md` | `rules/flows/team.md` |
